title.narrative: Alberto Baillères Foundation – UNESCO Project: Strengthening and consolidation of education communities through Fundación Alberto Baillères´ social model 2025-2027

description.narrative: The Social Model for the Strengthening of Educational Communities is an initiative of the Alberto Baillères Foundation. In 2017 earthquakes in Mexico affected schools’ infrastructure throughout the country and limited access to education for thousands of students. The initiative promotes a fuller exercise of the right to education in vulnerable areas of Mexico through the creation of educational habitats. This concept integrates the development of innovative and high-quality school infrastructure, and the generation of socio-community processes with students, teachers, families and educational authorities. UNESCO will assess transformations in educational communities, incorporate a comparative view that allows the identification of enabling factors for the development of educational communities, and disseminate practices that have consolidated during the operation of this initiative.
